_source: Owner decisions relayed 2026-11-09 (KG -> Muse -> Architect prompt 'council-zai-prompt-D-custom-table-2026-11-09.md' and 'claude-reply-owner-picks-D-2026-11-09.md'). Adopt D at theta=1.0, round to the nearest tier 0/2/6/12 (cutoffs 1/4/9), then apply the Owner's overrides. The Owner's list SUPERSEDES theta; each group below carries the Owner's own reason. Do not edit: this file is the decision record, not a draft.

remove_note.FS>RB: The Owner listed FS>RB as removed but no such rule exists in the 8 Nov table; no-op, recorded so the list is complete.
remove_note.EDGE>TE: The first version listed EDGE>TE in both the remove list and the -6 list. Owner clarification 2026-11-09: EDGE>TE is -6, NOT removed. See group 'override-6'.

groups.why: Owner set to -6 (2026-11-09). FB>TE and FB>RB are kept as just-in-case rules; C>OG, OLB>ILB and OLB>SS are Owner overrides DOWN from the rounding value (12); the rest are Owner overrides UP from the rounding value (0), on real-world grounds (blocking, unlikeness, specialist skills). EDGE>TE is -6 per the Owner's clarification.

Owner set to or kept at -12 (2026-11-09). TE>EDGE, RB>WR and TE>OT are the rounding rule on D (12.71/12.32/10.03); C>DT (14.3), C>OT (14.0) and OLB>EDGE (15.39) round to 12. RB>FS, RB>SS and TE>ILB are kept at 12 although D rounds to 6: the moves are so unlikely they stay heavily penalised. EDGE>SS, ILB>DIME, OLB>DIME, QB>FS and SS>RB are overrides UP from 0. QB>FS is the Owner-locked flex, -12.

rounding_note: Every rule not listed in remove or in a group keeps the tier the rounding rule gives: d < 1 -> 0, d < 4 -> 2, d < 9 -> 6, otherwise 12. The 8 Nov table already equals this rule for the rules the Owner did not mention, so the diff is exactly the Owner's 60 decisions.

engine_changes.finding: The Owner's prompt says the bump brings D for OLB>ILB/OLB>SS down to ~6.7 so 'the math agrees with -6'. That is not true of this engine: SLOTS[].weight is not an input to the matchup model, so D does not move at all when WILL/C are bumped (measured: 0 of 107 rules change; _agents/ds/notes/innovation-2026-11-09.md, D-DS-001). Both rules are therefore OWNER OVERRIDES, not rounding results.
